as_told.title: Chris Bledsoe's UFOs at his home in Fayetteville

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, from Fayetteville, North Carolina, says that from 2007 on he met beings in a craft, saw UFOs come to his house, and began talking with a divine figure he calls the Lady, at one point linked to the Egyptian goddess Hathor, who gives him prophecies once a year. After that, Michels says, senior figures from NASA and the CIA began visiting him: a high-ranking CIA official named Jim Semivan, and a man named Hal Puthoff, whom Michels places at the CIA and NASA and who, he says, turned up at Bledsoe's door once Bledsoe started attracting UFOs. Michels raises the case himself in many episodes, once citing a man named Timothy Taylor and the book UFO of God, as a sign that intelligence and space officials take such experiences seriously.
